payload.name: Free operations F and F_all

objects.convention: purity-preserving restriction; the broader SPO class F_all is defined but not the class used for the pure-state monotone statements
objects.object_type: set of deterministic pure-state stabilizer protocols

payload.statement: $\mathcal{F}_{\rm all}(A\to B)$ is the set of channels $\mathcal{O}$ with $\mathcal{Z}_\beta(\mathcal{O}(\phi_A))=\mathcal{Z}_\beta({\rm STAB}_B)$ for all $\phi_A\in{\rm STAB}_A$; the paper states this coincides with the stabilizer-preserving operations (SPO). Throughout the pure-state development, the operative class is $\mathcal{F}$: deterministic pure-state stabilizer protocols, namely Clifford unitaries, stabilizer-state preparation, computational-basis measurement, and partial trace, provided the resulting state stays pure.

producer.model: claude-opus-5 (single interactive execution; no separate reviewer process)
